extraction.notes: Three-month 2025 column only. FFO and Core FFO sums verified against printed totals. Share count printed as 66,670,784, divided by 1,000 to 66,670.784 thousand; reproduces $4.03 for both FFO (268,838) and Core FFO (268,554). Company reports no AFFO metric, so affo fields are null. Same reconciliation is repeated on page S-3 (seq 16); page 7 (seq 11) used as primary. Tax benefit on technology co-investments, provision for credit losses, and G&A and other, net were classified as 'other' because no other category fits. Depreciation attributable to third party ownership and other (-38) placed under nareit_other. Zero-value lines (impairment, expensed acquisition costs, debt extinguishment, promote income) are included as printed with amount 0.
